methods.prompt_v_last: V of the last token in prompt_ids
methods.prompt_v_mean: FP32 mean of V over every token in prompt_ids

prompt_ids: chat-templated user turn plus generation prompt; thinking disabled. Template tokens are included. Response tokens are not.
label: FineHarm filename _HP_ = 1, _BP_ = 0. Response harm is not the label.
early_stopping: dev group-equal BCE. Test is not used to pick the epoch.
threshold: calibration rows with prompt label 0, one row per prompt_group, target FPR from the config. Harmful calibration prompts are excluded.
